parts.text: Give me an MLB scouting matchup breakdown for the Los Angeles Dodgers (LAD) at the New York Yankees (NYY), including probable starters, platoon splits, and the Pythagorean/Log5 win probability edge.

The New York Yankees (NYY, 94-68) host the Los Angeles Dodgers (LAD, 98-64) in a premier interleague matchup featuring Gerrit Cole (3.18 ERA, 1.09 WHIP) against Yoshinobu Yamamoto (3.00 ERA, 1.11 WHIP). Using Pythagorean expectancy (1.83 exponent) and Log5 with home-field adjustment, NYY holds a 50.65% win probability vs LAD's 49.35%.
Compare the NHL special teams (PP% and PK%) and starting goalies for the Toronto Maple Leafs (TOR) at the Boston Bruins (BOS), and calculate the hockey matchup win probability.

Boston (BOS) posts a 104.7% Net Special Teams Index (22.2% PP, 82.5% PK) and starts Jeremy Swayman (.916 SV%, 2.53 GAA, +18.4 GSAx) against Toronto's (TOR) 100.9% Net Special Teams Index (24.0% PP, 76.9% PK) and Joseph Woll (.907 SV%, +6.2 GSAx). Boston holds a +3.8% special teams index edge, +12.2 GSAx goaltending advantage, and a 55.34% home-ice Log5 win probability.
